taxRates.title: Tax rates
taxRates.usedBy: Used by {{count}} items. Mark it inactive instead?
taxRates.hintSnapshot: Changes apply to new lines. Saved invoices keep their rates.
taxRates.hintAdvisor: Ask your tax advisor which category applies.
taxRates.name: Name

S.label: Standard rate
S.help: The normal VAT rate, for example 19 % or 20 %.

E.label: Exempt
E.help: Exempt from VAT by law. Needs a reason.

AE.label: Reverse charge
AE.help: The buyer pays the VAT. Needs a reason and the buyer's VAT ID.

K.label: Intra-community supply
K.help: Goods to a VAT-registered buyer in another EU country. Needs a reason.

G.label: Export outside the EU
G.help: No VAT is charged on the export. Needs a reason.

O.label: Outside the scope of VAT
O.help: Not subject to VAT, for example you are not VAT registered. Needs a reason.
